# Arithmetic builtins: + - * / % pow.

=== add
(+ 1 2)
--- want
3

=== add variadic
(+ 1 2 3 4)
--- want
10

=== add one
(+ 1)
--- want
1

=== add zero args is identity
(+)
--- want
0

=== add floats
(+ 0.1 0.2)
--- want
0.30000000000000004

=== sub
(- 10 3)
--- want
7

=== sub variadic
(- 10 3 2)
--- want
5

=== sub unary negates
(- 5)
--- want
-5

=== sub needs an argument
(-)
--- error

=== mul
(* 2 3)
--- want
6

=== mul variadic
(* 2 3 4)
--- want
24

=== mul zero args is identity
(*)
--- want
1

=== div
(/ 10 2)
--- want
5

=== div variadic
(/ 100 5 2)
--- want
10

=== div float result
(/ 1 4)
--- want
0.25

=== div by zero
(/ 1 0)
--- error

=== div zero by zero
(/ 0 0)
--- error

=== div by float zero
(/ 1 0.0)
--- error

=== div needs an argument
(/)
--- error

=== mod
(% 10 3)
--- want
1

=== mod is floored: negative divisor
(% 5 -3)
--- want
-1

=== mod is floored: negative dividend
(% -1 2)
--- want
1

=== mod exact
(% 7 7)
--- want
0

=== mod floats
(% 5.5 2)
--- want
1.5

=== mod negative float dividend
(% -5.5 2)
--- want
0.5

=== mod by zero
(% 1 0)
--- error

=== pow
(pow 2 10)
--- want
1024

=== pow fractional
(pow 2 0.5)
--- want
1.4142135623730951

# IEEE behavior on every host; Filo does not invent a real cube root.
=== pow of a negative base to a fractional exponent is NaN
(pow -8 (/ 1 3))
--- want
(number "nan")

=== pow zero zero
(pow 0 0)
--- want
1

=== pow arity
(pow 2)
--- error

=== type error
(+ 1 "a")
--- error

=== type error nested
(* 2 (+ 1 #t))
--- error

=== nested arithmetic
(+ (* 2 3) (- 10 4) (/ 8 2))
--- want
16

=== large integers stay exact
(+ 9007199254740992 1)
--- want
9007199254740992

=== unary division is the reciprocal
(/ 4)
--- want
0.25

=== unary division of one
(/ 1)
--- want
1

=== unary division of zero
(/ 0)
--- error
